service.en: Replace a lost or damaged citizen passport
service.ar: استبدال جواز سفر المواطن المفقود أو التالف
service.ur: گم یا خراب شہری پاسپورٹ کی تبدیلی

about: UAE citizens apply for a new passport to replace a lost or damaged one, or to update the photo.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: A photo showing the damage, if the passport is damaged
timing: Passport arrives by an authorised delivery company
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security
